# Drawer

A panel that slides up from the bottom, for phones.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-drawer--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:light" title="Drawer examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-drawer--docs">Open Drawer in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-drawer--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** The menu on a phone.

- **Use it when:** Filters, details or a short form on a phone, while the page stays partly in view.
- **Not when:** A blocking decision (dialog), or a wide screen where a side panel fits better (sheet).

Instead:

- [Sheet](./sheet.md): Slides from an edge on wide screens.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A blocking decision.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add drawer
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Drawer reads 14 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Drawer's tokens to change Drawer alone.
